jamie: Hey team :wave: Quick prep for this Friday's all-hands (10:00am PT). Posting agenda + where to drop Qs below — please skim the pre-reads by Wed EOD if you're presenting.

jamie: Agenda (short):
• 10:00 – Exec state & key metrics (10m)
• 10:10 – Product launches: Dedicated EU & Optimize features (10m)
• 10:20 – Privacy & policy updates (5m)
• 10:25 – Roadmap highlights + demos (10m)
• 10:35 – Q&A + shoutouts (15m)

jamie: Pre-reads: internal drive -> /company/allhands/2026-summer/ (slides + one-pager). Drop questions in this thread or add to the Google form: https://forms.internal.example.com/ah-questions

jamie: Recording link will be posted here after the meeting. If you need a speaking slot change, ping me or @sophia. :memo:

sophia: Will the deck be uploaded before Wed? I want to double-check the demo notes. :eyes:

jamie: Yes, deck + speaker notes going up by EOD Tue. If you need edits, send them to me today.

prashant: Can we make sure the PTO policy change is summarized for the all-hands? Folks will ask about accrual and carryover.

jamie: Good call. HR will do a 5m summary. We'll include a 1-slide FAQ: accrual rates, carryover cap, and transition timeline.

caoimhe: For the Dedicated EU launch callout — can someone add 2 bullets about expected latency gains and compliance posture? I can chop that into the slide.

prashant: I can draft the bullets and drop them here by Wed morning.

ops-bot: Event created: All-Hands — Summer Readout. When: Fri 10:00am PT. Where: Zoom (link in calendar). Organizer: jamie.

ekaterina: Adding a note to presenters: please record any terminal demos locally as backup (sometimes Zoom drops screen share).

jamie: Great. Asking presenters to keep demos under 5 minutes each.

--- (post-meeting) ---

tara: Recording: https://videos.internal.example.com/recordings/1849504000-allhands-summer-readout (captions generated). Slides + one-pager: https://drive.internal.example.com/company/allhands/2026-summer/deck.pdf

tara: Top takeaways:
• Exec: ARR growth ahead of plan; tight focus on unit economics this quarter.
• Product: Dedicated EU launched to limited customers; Optimize rollout starts next week.
• Policy: PTO accrual policy update — transition starts July 1; 40 hour carryover cap.
• Ops: New routing fallback reduces cross-region failover time by ~30ms median.

tara: Collected Qs and answers (short):
Q: Will Dedicated EU be available to self-serve? A: Initially invite-only, self-serve in Q4.
Q: How will PTO transition be communicated to managers? A: HR follow-up emails + 1:1 manager kit.
Q: Any change in uptime SLA? A: No SLA changes this quarter.

jamie: Thanks everyone who presented and submitted questions. If you want to add post-meeting notes, reply here or file follow-up in the all-hands doc. :tada:

prashant: Thanks — will post the Dedicated EU performance bullets I promised and a short changelog.

caoimhe: Appreciated — slide looks great.

ekaterina: Thanks team, nice sync.

ops-bot: Reminder: Recording and slides auto-archived to /company/allhands/2026-summer/.
